test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

7, 21, 13, 22, 19, ?
solution:
**Explanation:-**

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **Numbers placed at odd places have a difference of +6.**
 
• **Numbers placed at even places have a difference of +1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ca6effcc316825238c84443137af9da96c103d95698112caea3f5686e35124c.png] 

**Hence the correct answer is option 4.**
